name: Mate 10

Platform.Operating system: Android 10.0 Q with EMUI, Current: China: HarmonyOS 3
Platform.CPU: Octa-Core CPU (4*Cortex A73 2.36GHz + 4*Cortex A53 1.8GHz) + i7 co-processor + NPU (Neural Network Processing Unit)

Memory.RAM: Mate 10 & 10 Pro: 4/6 GB RAM LPDDR4X 1833MHz, Mate 10 Porsche Design: 6GB RAM LPDDR4X 1833MHz
Memory.Storage: Mate 10: 64 GB UFS 2.1, Mate 10 Pro: 64/128 GB UFS 2.1, Mate 10 Porsche Design: 256 GB UFS 2.1
Memory.Card slot: microSD up to 256 GB (Mate 10) (uses SIM 2 slot)

Cameras.Rear camera: 20MP Monochrome, 12MP RGB OIS, f/1.6, BSI CMOS, Dual-LED flash, PDAF+CAF+Laser+Depth AF, 2x Hybrid Zoom, 4K Video, RAW (DNG) (Only in 12MP Pro Mode), Leica Certified

Sound.Sound: 3.5mm Headphone Jack (Mate 10), Stereo Speakers, 32-bit/384kHz Dual DAC, Active Noise Cancellation With Dedicated Mic

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4G/5G, 802.11a/b/g/n/ac with Wi-Fi Direct support, BT4.2, BLE, aptX/aptX HD and LDAC HD Audio, USB Type C 3.1, DisplayPort 1.2
